title: Cormorant - provisioning & SE daily scratchpad
body:
Context: Harper Health (internal: Cormorant). POC/private deployment behind customer VPC. Goal: get dev preview (non-prod) up this week, then canary in prod next week. Notes to self / quick log.

Top priorities (today):
- [ ] Finish VPC peering test with Harper dev account (ask infra for route propagation check)
- [ ] Confirm KMS key access pattern with Harper security (need key ARN and allowed principals)
- [ ] Wire up log forwarding -> Harper Splunk endpoint (get endpoint URL + cert)
- [ ] Run end-to-end inference smoke test against Llama-2-13B-sft variant (quantized q4f16) and capture latency percentiles

Quick setup checklist (working):
1) Networking
   - Customer VPC CIDR: 10.240.0.0/16 (confirmed via email 2025-10-01)
   - Redwood private subnet suggestion: 10.240.32.0/20 (provisioned via tf)
   - Peering notes: need route for 10.240.0.0/16 -> redwood-managed-subnet 10.241.0.0/16. Ask infra to enable route-propagation on peer.
   - Security groups: ports 443 from customer NAT + 22 from Harper bastion only. Double-check bastion IP range (Maya to confirm).

2) Secrets & Keys
   - KMS key ARN placeholder: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/REDACTED (awaiting full ARN)
   - TODO: Request IAM policy snippet so Harper can grant: "kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*" to redwood-service-role

3) Model/versioning
   - Start with: redwood/llama-2-13b-sft@v1.4 (quant profile: q4f16)
   - If latency > 160ms p95 on instance type g5.12xlarge, fallback to 7B distil variant (redwood/llama-7b-distil@v2.1) for canary traffic
   - Pin model in deployment config: model_version: "redwood/llama-2-13b-sft@v1.4"

4) Capacity & SLOs
   - Expected P50 per-token latency target: <= 35ms, p95 <= 160ms (for 13B q4f16)
   - Expected sustained QPS: 80 req/s for dev preview, scale to 400 req/s for prod canary
   - Autoscale policy: min_replicas:2, target_concurrency:24, scale_out_step: +2 up to 12

5) Observability
   - Add trace hooks: include request_id header from customer and surface in traces
   - Logs: app + kernel-level logs forwarded to Harper Splunk. Set retention 30d (Harper ask).
   - Add custom evals: prompt set A / A/B comparing top-1 tokens for quality regression detection

Commands / quick ops notes (one-liners I keep repeating):
- terraform workspace select harper-dev && terraform apply -var-file=harper-dev.tfvars
- rctl deploy --env harper-dev --manifest manifests/cormorant-deploy.yml --tag v2025-10-14
- kubectl -n redwood-harper get pods --watch
- curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>" https://cormorant-api.internal/health

Open questions / things to ask customer (MUST clarify before prod):
- Do they require HSM-backed keys (HSM or KMS only)? If HSM, escalate to security for config guide.
- Network egress policy: do all model downloads need to be blocked? We should pre-stage model artifacts in S3 bucket under Harper account to avoid internet egress.
- SLA expectations for deduped requests (they asked about 99.9% but didn't specify per route)
- Compliance: Are there any particular PCI/PHI flows that require extra logging or redaction?

Meeting notes / timeline: 
- 2025-10-03 sync (Rajiv + Harper infra): agreed dev peering by 10/07.
- 2025-10-10 customer demo scheduled (aim to have dev preview stable). Action: bring perf numbers + short failover demo.

Customer-specific config snippets (pasteable):
- Deployment fragment (yaml):
  apiVersion: redwood/v1
  kind: Deployment
  metadata:
    name: cormorant-llama-13b
  spec:
    model_version: "redwood/llama-2-13b-sft@v1.4"
    resources: \"gpus: 2\"
    quant_profile: "q4f16"

- IAM policy snippet to send to Harper security:
  {
    \"Version\": \"2012-10-17\",
      \"Statement\": [
        {\"Effect\": \"Allow\", \"Action\": [\"kms:Decrypt\", \"kms:GenerateDataKey*\"], \"Resource\": \"<KMS-KEY-ARN>\"}
      ]
  }

Quick remediation checklist if perf is bad during demo:
- Switch to distill 7B variant via rollout config (canary -> 20% traffic)
- Increase batch timeout to 120ms to allow larger batching while monitoring p95
- Enable prefix cache for repeated user sessions (cache key: user_id+conversation_id)

Notes to self (log entries):
- 2025-10-02 09:12 — created scratchpad after kickoff with Harper.
- 2025-10-07 16:48 — peering established but route propagation missing on Harper side (contacted infra).
- 2025-10-12 11:30 — ran first smoke test, p95=198ms on g5.12xlarge (investigate kernel tuning + quant profile)

Random TODOs (low priority):
- Clean up old dev tfstate file in S3 (prefix: redwood-harper-dev)
- Draft quickstart for Harper devs: 'how to run local inference against the preview' (2 pager)

End of today's notes. Will tidy and move items to JIRA (SOL-987 subtasks) after demo.

Signature: Lena M. — ping me in Slack if anything blocks (slack: @lena.m)
